title: Hybrid identity orientation among members of Saudi mixed families
core_idea: The study investigates representations and orientations of hybrid identity among children of mixed Saudi families, the factors that contribute to its emergence, and how such orientations relate to integration or assimilation into Saudi society, using a qualitative case-study design with snowball sampling and semi-structured remote interviews.
tldr: A qualitative case study examining how hybrid identities develop among children of mixed Saudi families and how those identity orientations relate to social integration, based on remote semi-structured interviews with a small purposive sample.
